frames.title: A Salesforce step on a working connection: Pennie Salesforce
A Salesforce step on a connection with a problem: Achieve Salesforce

decisions.decision: On the canvas, a step's Connection field is the app's dropdown with the chosen connection's name, with only "Acts as <who>" under it; nothing about status on a healthy day, and a red line only when the connection has a problem.
decisions.why: Rounds 8 and 8b: who the step acts as is the fact a builder needs; a healthy status is noise.
decisions.check: The Connection field is a dropdown reading the chosen connection's name with "Acts as <who>" under it and nothing else on a working connection; on a connection with a problem one more line reads its status (Needs reconnecting) in red.

decisions.decision: Blue is for buttons only; links are dark and underlined.
decisions.check: Nothing in the Connection field is coloured blue (#1B72BA) in its text or background outside a button.

decisions.decision: Red is only for something genuinely wrong.
decisions.check: Red (#B42318) appears in the step panel only on the line saying the connection has a problem.

decisions.decision: No line of text ends with a single word on its own line. A rule for all of Bidspoke's copy, made by Dan on 2026-10-20 in these rounds.
decisions.check: No block of text in the Connection field wraps so that its last line holds a single word (the other fields are the product's copy as it is today, not decided here).

idioms: The step panel is drawn inside a captured copy of the canvas at 1120 wide; the canvas, the panel's header and the other fields are the product as it is today, not decisions.
